text: so then just remount it then. dont try to figure it out, just play it dumb, on updates, unmount and remount it
resolution: Forced the trace backdrop to remount fresh on every mount, per the user's directive to stop diagnosing and just remount it. The image kept returning offset/reshaped after a code update while the camera was provably identical (crosshair/box/grid in the same screen spot); its localstore data round-trips fine, so the leftover was a host-cached geometry/texture bake keyed by the STABLE bd.id surviving the reload. Fix: a per-mount epoch (nowMs at mount, via useRef) folded into the backdrop mesh geometry id, dynamicKey, textureKey, and React key, plus the matching BackdropSurface staticKey — so each mount bakes the image fresh and no stale bake can be reused. Verified the textureKey still matches the surface staticKey via self-shot (image renders, not blank); built green. Hot-reload behavior needs a live confirm (can't self-shot an update). SHA e9a69e9de. NOTE for follow-up: this is the 'play dumb' remount; the underlying stale-bake cause (host geometry/texture cache reuse across hot reload on a stable id) is still unexplained and may bite other persisted Scene3D content.
